title: Every LIE Pins a Tag to You 🏷️
description:
In this town, every lie you tell pins a small white tag to your clothes. The man who sells shoes looks like a snowman. I've never had a single one.

I came home for a week to help my uncle shut the little alterations shop where he taught me to cut. Every time a customer asks after me, another tag lands on him. And at night, someone keeps chalking up my old bench for a suit.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment TAG with how many you'd be wearing.
